summary: Confidence-gate substrate delivered exactly to spec: two optional schema fields, a pure total bucketing helper exported through both barrels, and a read-only `confidence gate` CLI subcommand. tsc passes clean (exit 0). All invariants hold (postmortem/LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD untouched, MCP write-surface handler unchanged, no writer flags added, helper is pure). One non-blocking environmental note: the globally-installed `luca` bin is stale (v13.0.0-alpha.8) so the `gate` subcommand cannot be exercised through it; runtime correctness is established by composition (type-checked thin CLI wrapper + proven empty-journal -> [] + pure total helper).

criteria.evidence: schemas.ts:58 `researchable: z.boolean().optional()`; schemas.ts:63 `resolution: z.enum(['auto','research','ask']).optional()`. ConfidenceLevelSchema (13), ConfidenceCategorySchema (17), ConfidenceSummary (68) unchanged.

criteria.description: selectConfidenceGateActions(entries) is pure, returns {auto,research,ask,counts}, implements locked precedence with a TOTAL final else->ask branch.
criteria.evidence: gate.ts:39-68. No Date./Math./fs/node: refs (grep clean). Precedence: resolution wins (47-50) -> high->auto (51) -> medium->auto (53) -> low+researchable->research (55) -> else->ask (57). Total: every entry hits exactly one branch. Traces: {low}->ask (else); {low,researchable:true}->research; {medium}->auto; {low,resolution:'auto'}->auto (resolution override). counts = bucket lengths (66).
